rows.rationale: Keeps the three genitive pairs and their Christ-centered horizon.

rows.after: Before our God and Father, we continually remember your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
rows.tsw_comparator: remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

rows.exact_source_record: αὐτοὶ γὰρ περὶ ἡμῶν ἀπαγγέλλουσιν ὁποίαν εἴσοδον ἔσχομεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ πῶς ἐπεστρέψατε πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων δουλεύειν θεῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἀληθινῷ,

rows.rationale: Preserves apostolic claim and the explicitly maternal caregiving image.
rows.before: though as Christ’s apostles we could have made demands. Instead, we became gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring tenderly for her own children.
rows.after: Though we could have asserted our weight as Christ's apostles, we became gentle among you, like a nursing mother tenderly caring for her own children.

rows.rationale: Keeps intense affection and self-sharing beyond speech.
rows.before: Having such deep affection for you, we were pleased to share with you not only God’s good news but also our own lives, because you had become beloved to us.
rows.after: Because we yearned for you, we were pleased to share with you not only God's good news but our own lives as well, since you had become dear to us.
rows.tsw_comparator: So, having deep affection for you, we were pleased to share with you not only the good news of God but also our own lives, because you had become dear to us.
rows.exact_source_record: οὕτως ὁμειρόμενοι ὑμῶν εὐδοκοῦμεν μεταδοῦναι ὑμῖν οὐ μόνον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ψυχάς, διότι ἀγαπητοὶ ἡμῖν ⸀ἐγενήθητε.

rows.rationale: Keeps local perpetrators distinct and does not generalize the polemic beyond the comparison.

rows.rationale: Keeps the prohibited mission, accumulated sins and judgment claim.

rows.after: hindering us from speaking to the nations so that they may be saved. In this way they always fill up their sins. But wrath has overtaken them at last.

rows.rationale: Retains the unusual orphan image and face/heart contrast.

rows.after: But when we were orphaned from you, brothers and sisters, for a short time—in person, not in heart—we made every effort, with great longing, to see you face to face.

rows.rationale: Keeps the suffering real and the difficult appointment language.
rows.before: so that no one would be shaken by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are destined for this.

rows.after: that no one transgress and exploit a brother or sister in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as we told you before and solemnly warned you.

rows.rationale: Retains sleep metaphor, grief and the comparison without forbidding grief itself.

rows.after: We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about those who are sleeping, so that you do not grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

rows.rationale: Keeps death explicit for Jesus and sleep for the deceased.
rows.before: For if we trust that Jesus died and rose, in the same way God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep through him.
rows.after: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose, in the same way God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep through him.

rows.after: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a commanding shout, with an archangel's voice and with God's trumpet, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
